name: Decky Power & Controller Plugins (safe setup)
summary: Installs SimpleDeckyTDP v1.0.7 (per-game TDP, CPU boost, SMT, EPP, GPU controls in Gaming Mode) and LegionGoRemapper v0.3.0 (Legion Go button remapping, RGB, fan curves, charge limit) from their official releases, verified by SHA-256, with our safety patch for LegionGoRemapper and conservative starting settings: boost and SMT on, EPP balance_performance, no SMU write at startup, and every LegionGoRemapper feature off until you enable it.
restart: Open the Quick Access menu > Decky in Gaming Mode to use the plugins.
